summary: Shopping-centre drop-off kerb on Moggill Road with loading and no-stopping signs.
reasons: Loading zone, 2P and No Stopping signs
Main road kerb, no parked cars on it

drivers.seclusion: Backs onto a large shopping centre; no homes within 10 m, but it is a busy, overlooked commercial frontage.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerb curves round a drop-off apron at a junction; no clear room to pull fully off the lane.
drivers.traffic: Moggill Road, a main road, with junction, pedestrian crossing and centre entrance.
drivers.convention: 2P Mon-Sat daytime, loading zone and No Stopping Any Time signs; no overnight pattern.

flags: Steep: about 7.5% mean, up to 12% max
No Stopping Any Time sign close
sun_shade: Trees shade the south end; building shades the west side in the afternoon.
